args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Monitoring to confirm recovery.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Actions taken

1. **Investigated** — `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with `healthy: false` and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back** — Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified (`status: rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident** — Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer, describing the failure and the rollback to v2.3.0.

## Verification

Post-rollback status confirms recovery: `checkout-api` is now on v2.3.0 in all regions, `healthy: true`, with error rate down to 0.2%.

Note: v2.3.1 remains the latest release; the incident is open so the on-call engineer can investigate the root cause before any re-deploy attempt.
